industry.why: Underweight, carried, on the special topic of 30-Oct-26 ('Why the Defence Industry de-rated from July to October 2026 while Theon's forecasts rose'), whose first dated test, Rheinmetall's print on 5-Nov-26, did not reach this pack, so the conversion question is open and untested; the Bundestag budget vote on 27-Nov-26 is the next. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-11-06 against 2026-09-04, not week on week: F now, F prior, the fourth reading at F; both sectors F. Component 1 regime, 6-Nov-26 (risk-off beneath an index at its high, now present in Europe's own prices: the STOXX Europe 600 0.9% from its 52-week high with the share of stocks above the 100, 150 and 200-day averages at or below the tenth percentile of near-high days since 2006, defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows, breadth recovering for a second week; the causes, inflation, rates, yields, credit and the consumer, unread this week because the strategist and newsletter files did not reach the pack, so the credit-and-cost-of-debt read of 30-Oct-26 with the US ten-year above 5% is held one week stale; sources present 2026-W45, headline-only); ceasefire talks on Ukraine (headlines, 2 November) are the least-supported cause named last week and move shares for days. One live holding, Theon (3.46%, from 4.05%, Fitness 40.6, memo re-triaged 5-Nov-26), judged in components 4 and 5; no Pool name. Counter-case: estimates have not fallen and the premium compression may already be the exit multiple. Back to C if relative strength leaves F as approvals convert; to F on a signed settlement followed by defence fund outflows.

sector.why: Underweight, carried, on the special topic of 30-Oct-26 on the Defence de-rating: the land and ammunition names here were hit hardest, and the first dated chance for conversion to show, Rheinmetall's print on 5-Nov-26, was not read this week. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-11-06 against 2026-09-04, not week on week: F now, D prior. Component 1 regime, 6-Nov-26 (risk-off beneath an index at its high, now present in Europe's own prices: the STOXX Europe 600 0.9% from its 52-week high with the share of stocks above the 100, 150 and 200-day averages at or below the tenth percentile of near-high days since 2006, defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows, breadth recovering for a second week; the causes, inflation, rates, yields, credit and the consumer, unread this week because the strategist and newsletter files did not reach the pack, so the credit-and-cost-of-debt read of 30-Oct-26 with the US ten-year above 5% is held one week stale; sources present 2026-W45, headline-only). Counter-case: large, proven, government-contracted cases are what a risk-off market is meant to pay for. Back to C when relative strength leaves F with approvals converting at the 27-Nov-26 Bundestag vote.

geography.why: Neutral, carried; the re-test written last week (Neutral against Underweight after the Bank of England's decision and guidance on 5-Nov-26) could not run, because no source in the pack reports the outcome; the only United Kingdom items are undated headlines (the pound firmer on policy divergence; shoppers 'more upbeat than their European counterparts', City AM, against a GfK 'weakens in November' headline most likely from 2025). Component 1 regime, 6-Nov-26 (risk-off beneath an index at its high, now present in Europe's own prices: the STOXX Europe 600 0.9% from its 52-week high with the share of stocks above the 100, 150 and 200-day averages at or below the tenth percentile of near-high days since 2006, defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows, breadth recovering for a second week; the causes, inflation, rates, yields, credit and the consumer, unread this week because the strategist and newsletter files did not reach the pack, so the credit-and-cost-of-debt read of 30-Oct-26 with the US ten-year above 5% is held one week stale; sources present 2026-W45, headline-only). The Budget read of last week stands: a UK-specific fiscal tail risk removed without lowering the rate; 22 of the Pool stocks are UK-listed and a Neutral country carries no weight in Thematic Fit/Momentum. Counter-case unchanged: a 1.0% growth year with a hiking central bank is an Underweight in most books. To D on hawkish guidance when the 5-Nov-26 decision is read, a January price cap above 16% or a spring fiscal event with broad taxes; to B if a second source makes the UK case with the rate path read.

defs.atr: average true range: each day's high to low, stretched to the previous close on a gap, as a % of the previous close; L5D the last 5 sessions, L1M and L3M the last 30 and 91 calendar days
defs.top_half: a close above the midpoint of the day's high-low range; an up day closes at or above the previous close; days with no range are left out
